# ContrastVerdict

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

The outcome of comparing a text colour to its resolved backdrop.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Properties

- [`IsIndeterminate`](#isindeterminate): True when the backdrop could not be resolved; `Reason` says why.
- [`Passed`](#passed): True when the measured ratio meets the required one.
- [`Ratio`](#ratio): Measured ratio, rounded to 2 decimal places.
- [`Reason`](#reason): Why the backdrop was unresolvable.
- [`Required`](#required): The ratio required at this text size.


True when the backdrop could not be resolved; `Reason` says why.

### `Passed`

```csharp
bool Passed { get; set; }
```

True when the measured ratio meets the required one. Meaningless when indeterminate.

### `Ratio`

```csharp
double Ratio { get; set; }
```

### `Reason`

```csharp
ContrastUnknownReason Reason { get; set; }
```

Why the backdrop was unresolvable. Meaningful only when indeterminate.

### `Required`

```csharp
double Required { get; set; }
```

The ratio required at this text size. Meaningless when indeterminate.

## Methods

- [`Indeterminate`](#indeterminate): Creates a verdict for text whose backdrop could not be resolved, with the reason.
- [`Measured`](#measured): Creates a verdict from a measured contrast ratio and the ratio required; it passes when the ratio meets the requirement.
